_comment: CANONICAL ROUND MANIFEST — the SINGLE source of truth for the live deployment. Consumed by BOTH the indexer (ponder.config.ts + start.mjs via ./deployments/round.json) AND the frontend (src/config/cauldron.ts + perp.ts via ../../indexer/deployments/round.json). It lives inside indexer/ because `railway up` only uploads that dir. To ship a new round: bump `round` + `schema` (new schema forces a clean reindex), update the addresses/poolIds/blocks, then run `node scripts/deploy-round.mjs --push`. NEVER set these as Railway env vars — env overrides silently drift (that caused the r29-served-as-r31 incident).
